description: This schema defines the structure of OneNote notebook resources. Each item represents a notebook containing sections and pages.
title: OneNotes

OneNote.description: A OneNote notebook containing sections and pages. Represents the top-level organizational unit in OneNote.

NotebookName.description: The name of the OneNote notebook. Notebook names typically represent projects, topics, or functional areas (e.g., 'Q3 Planning', 'Research Notes', 'Team Standup Notes').

Owner.description: The alias (username) of the notebook owner. This is the user under whose OneDrive or site the notebook is created.

DestinationType.description: Indicates whether the notebook is stored in the user's personal OneDrive or a SharePoint site.

DestinationSiteName.description: The name of the destination SharePoint site. Only applicable when DestinationType is 'site'.

Sections.description: The sections within this notebook. Each section contains one or more pages.

Section.description: A section within a OneNote notebook. Sections organize pages by subtopic or category.

SectionName.description: The name of the section (e.g., 'Meeting Notes', 'Action Items', 'References').

Page.description: A page within a OneNote section.

PageId.description: A unique identifier for the page within the dataset.

PageTitle.description: The title of the OneNote page.

CreatedDate.description: The timestamp of the page's creation in ISO 8601 format.
